title: When the Wardrobe Breaks
author: Tamsin Amberdale
blurb: Isandro Ishikawa, a restaurant critic who has forgotten how food tastes, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. But when a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must return to the place where the story went wrong before the demolition date arrives.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
